body.statement:
Let
\[
 \mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}
 =\left\{\lambda\ge0:
 \sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\sum_{r\in\mathcal R_x}\lambda_{xr}=1,
 \ \sum_{r\in\mathcal R_x}\lambda_{xr}\ge\pi_*\ \forall x,
 \ \sum_{x,r}\lambda_{xr}
 \mathbf 1\{D_r(1)>D_r(0),S_r(0)=S_r(1)=1\}\ge m_*
 \right\}.
\]
Then
\[
 \mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}
 =T_0\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}
 =\{q\in\Delta(\mathcal J):\Xi(q)\ne\varnothing\}
 =\{q\in\Delta(\mathcal J):\mathcal F(q)\ne\varnothing\}.
\]
It is a rational polytope. Exact rational elimination first decides whether it is empty.  When it is nonempty, the finite rational response-type data yield an irredundant relative representation
\[
 \mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}=\{q:Eq=e,\ F_iq\le f_i,\ i\in I\},
 \qquad
 \operatorname{aff}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})=\{q:Eq=e\},
\]
and therefore certify \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\) by exact rational linear programming and row-space arithmetic.
body.proof_tex:
The technique is finite response-type projection followed by exact rational polyhedral elimination.  Remove the equation \(T_0\lambda=p\) from the definition of \(\Xi(p)\); the remaining constraints are exactly those defining \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).  Consequently, for every \(q\in\Delta(\mathcal J)\),
\[
 \Xi(q)\ne\varnothing
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \exists\lambda\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\text{ with }T_0\lambda=q
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 q\in T_0\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}. \tag{1}
\]
The already established response-type fiber equivalence gives
\[
 \Xi(q)\ne\varnothing
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \mathcal F(q)\ne\varnothing. \tag{2}
\]
Equations (1) and (2), together with the definition of \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), prove all three set equalities.

All coefficients in \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) and \(T_0\) are rational.  Nonnegativity and unit total mass imply \(0\le\lambda_{xr}\le1\), so \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) is bounded; it is closed because it is the intersection of finitely many closed rational half-spaces and hyperplanes.  Moreover, because \(\bar\pi_0(x)+\bar\pi_1(x)=1\),
\[
 \sum_{j\in\mathcal J}(T_0\lambda)_j
 =\sum_{x,r}\lambda_{xr}\sum_{z=0}^1\bar\pi_z(x)=1,
\]
and every coordinate of \(T_0\lambda\) is nonnegative.  Eliminate the finitely many coordinates of \(\lambda\) from
\[
 \lambda\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}},\qquad q=T_0\lambda
\]
by successive pairwise inequality elimination.  To verify exactness of one step, isolate a coordinate \(x\) and write its constraints as
\[
 \ell_s(y)\le x\quad(s\in S),\qquad
 x\le u_t(y)\quad(t\in T),\qquad
 g_k(y)\le0\quad(k\in K),
\]
where all displayed functions are rational affine functions.  Such an \(x\) exists exactly when
\[
 \ell_s(y)\le u_t(y)\quad\forall(s,t)\in S\times T,
 \qquad g_k(y)\le0\quad\forall k\in K;
\]
if \(S\) or \(T\) is empty, choose \(x\) beyond the finitely many one-sided bounds.  Thus one step is equivalent to finitely many rational inequalities.  Iteration gives a finite rational system for \(T_0\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).  The image is bounded because \(q\in\Delta(\mathcal J)\).  Hence \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) is a rational polytope.

The same elimination decides emptiness.  Conditional on nonemptiness, redundancy of any output inequality is decided by maximizing its rational left-hand side subject to the other rational constraints.  Gaussian elimination applied to the equalities that hold throughout the resulting polytope gives rational matrices \(E,e\) with affine hull \(Eq=e\); the remaining nonredundant inequalities are the relative facets \(F_iq\le f_i\).  Hence
\[
 p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 Ep_0=e\ \text{ and }\ F_ip_0<f_i\ \forall i\in I. \tag{3}
\]
Moreover
\[
 \operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)=\ker E,
 \qquad
 \operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad EB=0. \tag{4}
\]
Every comparison in (3) and every equality in (4) is exact rational arithmetic.  This proves the certification claim.
